استكبرن (form X)
# اِسْتَكْبَرْنَ (istakbarna) /is.tak.bar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
# اُسْتُكْبِرْنَ (ustukbirna) /us.tuk.bir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
# اِسْتَكْبِرْنَ (istakbirna) /is.tak.bir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
